title: Repo: /home/n3o/code/aura-harness (Rust workspace). The native desktop UI lives in crates/surface/aura-desktop and prob…
summary: The left pane isn't drawn natively by the desktop app. `aura-desktop` draws the terminal UI (`aura_ui_terminal::App`, built with ratatui) on a GPU cell grid, as its `lib.rs` says at lines 1-13. So the agent rows, hover state, hit-testing and the archive event all live in `crates/ui/aura-ui-terminal`. The desktop side only forwards pointer events cell by cell and decides how each glyph is drawn.
